prompt.text:
Pixel-art sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shoot-'em-up: the two animation frames of the OPTION HUNTER — an armoured grabber that hunts the player's Option drones with two pincer claws.

Design identity to keep exactly — a compact violet armoured pod about 4:3 wider-than-tall: a rounded-rectangle chassis in mid violet (#8a3ad8) with lighter lilac face plates (#c890ff) and deep plum shadow edges (#4a1a7a), a horizontal crimson eye slit (#ff3860) with a small white glint (#ffe0f0) across its centre, and two slender silver-grey claw arms (#b0b0c0) reaching from its upper-left and lower-left toward the left edge — open pincers on the LEFT, the threat side; all on a 1-px near-black outline (#140a20).

Rebuild it as a sprite sheet under this strict contract:
- On a CONTINUOUS flat pure bright green chroma-key background, exactly hex #51e018, identical solid colour in every background pixel: no gradient, no vignette, no shadow, no floor plane, no panel, no second green shade.
- EXACTLY 2 square cells laid out as 1 ROW OF 2 (2-column by 1-row) — every cell holding exactly ONE hunter; a missing, empty or merged cell ruins the entire sheet.
- Cells in reading order (left-right, then top-bottom):
  cell 1 = the hunter with claws at FULL REACH — arms stretched wide toward the left, eye slit dim with the white glint at its upper edge. The subject lies within aspect 0.90:1 to 1.70:1.
  cell 2 = the SAME hunter MID-GRAB — claws drawn in closer to the pod, eye slit blazing with the white glint dropped to its lower edge; chassis unchanged. The subject lies within aspect 0.90:1 to 1.70:1.
- The sheet canvas measures EXACTLY 512×256 px. Produce EXACTLY 2 subject cells — no more, no fewer — and nothing else on the sheet.
- Each subject sits well inside its cell with at least 12 px of unbroken flat #51e018 around it and clean flat gutters between cells: no subject may touch or cross a cell edge; keep every subject within the inner 75% of its cell.
- CENTRING AND SIZE: every subject sits at the exact centre of its cell at the same scale and position as the other cell — only the named state changes.
- NO guide lines, NO cell borders, NO divider lines, NO frames, NO text, NO labels, NO numbers anywhere on the sheet — the cell names above are ordering instructions and must NEVER be drawn.
- Style: the finest retro pixel art for its native resolution — as much detail and inner structure as possible AT that low resolution, crisp hard-edged square pixels, chunky bold forms, a rich four-to-six step shading ramp lit from the top-left with careful inner detail and real material texture, clean saturated colours, a 1-px near-black outline on every silhouette edge, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no smooth gradients.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, letters, labels, numbers, cell borders, guide lines, grid lines, watermark, signature, blurry, anti-aliasing, smooth gradient background, scenery, stars, cast shadow, drop shadow, multiple subjects per cell, empty cell, cropped subject, subject touching edge

enemies/* sprite maps still interim/upscaled, usage-ranked): enemies/option-hunter (2f 16×12 → 24×18 served; Option Hunter, grab pulse frames) incl its auto-derived @flash sibling — the 2 cells cropped to their measured subject boxes with the 6-px key border clamped inside each cell; state xors 59.9% over the interim animation floor 0.4%.
